issues.what: replaces the distant, sleek, tapering curved horn with a massive, close, blocky striated cliff face that lacks atmospheric haze
issues.fix: reshape the background landform into a slender, curved, tapering sea stack set much further back and softened by misty blue-grey haze

issues.where: distant curved rock formations across the strait
issues.what: replaces the slender, sharply pointed mist-veiled sea spires with two stubby, blunt-ended hooked rock arches that sit too close and dark
issues.fix: replace the chunky hooked arches with multiple slender, tapering upward-curving sea stacks recessed deep into coastal mist

issues.where: left and right flanking cliff walls
issues.what: crushed into nearly solid black voids at the base with muddy low-resolution rock texture and none of the thick hanging olive kelp fronds seen in the target
issues.fix: lift the shadow exposure on the flanking cliffs, add detailed wet craggy rock relief, and drape dense glistening olive-brown kelp down the lower walls

issues.where: stepped nesting cliff rock, lichen, and lower kelp
issues.what: reads as blocky stepped geometry with stretched vertical orange lichen stripes, no white guano streaks, no woven nests, and spiky dark kelp strips instead of wet hanging fronds
issues.fix: break up the blocky steps into organic fractured rock, replace stretched lichen with crusty patches, add dripping white guano streaks and woven nests on the ledges, and replace the spiky base with wet overlapping kelp fronds

issues.where: foreground tidal water and rocky shoreline
issues.what: water reads as a flat, featureless, glassy mirror plane with hard unblended rock intersections and a sandy front edge instead of rippling shallow tide pools and wet seaweed-covered cobbles
issues.fix: add fine wind ripples, broken specular highlights, foam edges along the rocks, and wet kelp-covered pebbles across the shallow tidal flat

issues.where: winged creatures flying over the strait
issues.what: appear overly pale and stiff with bright opaque orange wings and rigid straight stick-like legs that pierce the water without splashes
issues.fix: darken and backlight the creatures to sit naturally in the misty overcast light, refine their wing and leg proportions, mute the wing color, and add water splashes where they lift off

issues.where: perched colony creatures on the cliff ledges
issues.what: much sparser on the upper ledges, with rigid stone-like ribbed folded wings, chalky pale shading, stiff postures, and weak or missing dangling facial tendrils
issues.fix: increase colony density across the ledges, give the folded wings and bodies softer leathery shading with warm translucent backlit wing edges, and restore the long drooping facial tendrils

issues.where: sky, sea spray, and overall atmospheric haze
issues.what: dark churning charcoal clouds and wispy smoke-like spray plumes replace the luminous overcast sky, bright upper-right cloud break, and diffused backlit ocean mist
issues.fix: lighten the sky with a soft silver cloud break on the upper right and fill the strait with fine backlit sea mist that smoothly separates foreground, wave, and distant spires

issues.where: lighting, contact shadows, and depth across the cliff
issues.what: flatter, more uniform lighting lacks deep contact shadows under the perched creatures and soft silver rim-light from the overcast sky break
issues.fix: deepen ambient occlusion and contact shadows on the ledges, match the cool misty depth gradient, and add soft overcast rim-lighting along the rock edges and creatures

issues.where: close-up rock and lichen surfaces in both crop panels
issues.what: native-size crops reveal low-resolution smeared rock textures, stretched vertical orange bands, and faceted geometry with none of the crisp lichen granularity or guano drips of the target
issues.fix: increase rock displacement and texture resolution, eliminate UV stretching on vertical faces, and add crisp granular lichen and layered white guano streaks

issues.where: close-up shoreline, creature legs, and left cliff face in both crop panels
issues.what: native-size crops show untextured angular pale legs cutting cleanly into a smooth plastic water plane and a muddy, blobby dark cliff surface with zero kelp detail
issues.fix: add anatomical detail and organic texture to the legs, add ripples and foam at the water contact, and replace the low-res dark cliff shader with high-detail wet rock and individual hanging kelp strands
